steps.guidance: Set some basic parameters, such as Base_url, username and password
Call /v1/cl/network/list to search all network neighbors and extract the default network neighbor. Output its network_id.
Call /v1/cl/network/fetch with network_id to retrieve full configuration, including ipv4_static_host_list.
Call /v1/cl/network/tags/fetch with network_id to retrieve component tags.
Call /v1/cl/testcase/component/create with type=2 to create a DDoS component. Extract returned configuration parameters.

Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/profile/list to retrieve all attack profiles, then Select an attack profile from the returned results that matches or contains the attack_name. Output profile_id and profile_name.
Call /v1/cl/testcase/fetch with testcase_id to retrieve complete configuration parameters.

steps.description: Save testcase after modifying DDoS attack profile
steps.guidance: The parameters for the /v1/cl/testcase/save endpoint are formed by merging the testcase_config and ddos_attack_component_config objects, update the profile_id in ddos_attack_compoent_config. Output the new testcase_id.
Call /v1/cl/testcase/run with testcase_id and testcase_name to start executing the testcase.
Call /v1/cl/user/logout with the current username (e.g., admin) to terminate the session.
